name: Memory Flickers
source:
One day, all the tears will turn into fragments of memories.

Embracing irreplaceable kindness, the world will be filled with happiness――


Gentle days pass by as if they were a matter of course.

I believed that tomorrow would always come.

I thought her smile would last forever.

But... I didn’t realize that everything had already ended.

“...I was always so happy...”


Beginning with the end, it tells the stories of five happinesses.


[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020301224923/http://www21.tok2.com/home/sequoia/softs/memoryce.htm]the official website[/url]]
